decks.name: LeetCode #74 - Search a 2D Matrix
decks.description: Search for a target value in a sorted 2D matrix using binary search

cards.question: Search a 2D Matrix: You are given an m x n integer matrix with the following properties: Integers in each row are sorted from left to right. The first integer of each row is greater than the last integer of the previous row. Given an integer target, return true if target is in matrix or false otherwise. You must write a solution in O(log(m * n)) time complexity.

solutions.name: Binary Search (One Pass)
solutions.explanation: Treat the 2D matrix as a flattened 1D sorted array and perform standard binary search. Convert mid index to row and column using division and modulo. Most efficient approach with single binary search pass.

semanticLines: Define function searchMatrix that accepts 2D matrix and target.
Store number of rows in rows and number of columns in cols.
Initialize l to zero and r to total elements minus one calculated as rows times cols minus one.
Start while loop that continues while l is less than or equal to r.
Calculate midpoint m by adding l to the result of r minus l divided by two using integer division.
Calculate row by dividing m by cols using integer division and col by taking m modulo cols.
Check if element at row and col in matrix equals target.
If equal, return True as target found.
Otherwise check if element at row and col in matrix is less than target.
If less, set l to m plus one to search right half.
Otherwise element is greater than target.
Set r to m minus one to search left half.
After loop ends, return False indicating target not found.
codeLines: row, col = m // cols, m % cols

solutions.name: Binary Search (Two Pass)
solutions.explanation: First binary search to find the correct row, then binary search within that row. Two separate binary searches: one vertical to locate row, one horizontal within that row.

solutions.name: Staircase Search
solutions.explanation: Start from top-right corner and move like climbing stairs. If current value is greater than target, move left. If less, move down. Works because of sorted properties in both dimensions.

semanticLines: Define function searchMatrix that accepts 2D matrix and target.
Store number of rows in m and number of columns in n.
Initialize r to zero for row position and c to n minus one for column position at top right corner.
Start while loop that continues while r is less than m and c is greater than or equal to zero.
Check if element at row r and column c in matrix is greater than target.
If greater, decrement c to move left.
Otherwise check if element at row r and column c in matrix is less than target.
If less, increment r to move down.
Otherwise element equals target.
Return True as target found.
After loop ends, return False indicating target not found.
